items.difficulty_reason: The proof uses a finite-free-per-degree Mumford complex, compares fibre maps on cycles, and identifies two adjacent differentials whose local splitting controls base change and freeness.
source_caveats: The hypotheses include properness, a locally Noetherian base and a coherent base-flat sheaf. The occurrence of q ∈ X in the introduction to the proof is recorded as printed; the theorem and tensor products use q on Y. Exercise 14.2.K supplies the standard local matrix criterion.
